meta.title: Add yearly and monthly sitemap organization for large sites
meta.body_summary: Implements a sitemap organizational scheme by year and month for large WordPress sites, aiming to improve crawl budget, generation speed, and cache efficiency.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot sitemap organization feature linked to issue; no reviews or comments yet, claim of improved performance without benchmarks.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 497 changed lines across 9 files, this is a medium-sized feature addition by absolute volume. The PR adds a new sitemap indexing scheme for large WordPress sites; it is currently open with no review activity, consistent with a pending state.

review_details.concern_detail: No reviews or comments have been posted yet; the PR remains open awaiting maintainer attention.
review_details.performance_claim: Yearly/monthly sitemap organization improves crawl budget, generation speed, and cache efficiency for large sites.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Feature addition that touches multiple plugin components with no performance benchmarks; the PR has received no reviews, suggesting maintainers may be waiting for evidence or the integration workflow stalled.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmarks, profiler mentions, or reproduction steps provided; only narrative description of expected benefits.

core_change_summary.description: Adds yearly and monthly sitemap options in the SEO Framework WordPress plugin, modifying sitemap generation to filter content by year/month via date_query, and introducing new UI toggles and URL parameters.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Minor changes to plugin settings, JavaScript and readme for UI and documentation.
change_trajectory: Added yearly/monthly UI options and JS toggles.
Implemented core sitemap logic in Base and Registry classes.
Fixed regex sanitization and URL generation.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR linked to issue #649, added commits for UI and backend logic, review requested but no human response yet.
